_about: Public-domain John Todd (1800-1873), Congregational minister of Pittsfield, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: Lectures to Children (1844), The Young Man (1845), The Student's Manual (1850 printing), Summer Gleanings (1852), The Daughter at School (1854) and The Sabbath School Teacher (1856 printing). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 60 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jtodd-lectures-to-children: Lectures to children : familiarly illustrating important truth (Northampton : J.H. Butler, 1844)
jtodd-young-man: The young man. Hints addressed to the young men of the United States (Northampton, J.H. Butler; Buffalo, J.H. Butler & Co., 1845)
jtodd-students-manual: The student's manual : designed, by specific directions, to aid in forming and strengthening the intellectual and moral character and habits of the student (Northampton, [Mass] : Hopkins, Bridgman & Co., 1850)
jtodd-summer-gleanings: Summer gleanings, or, Sketches and incidents of a pastor's vacation (Northampton : Hopkins, Bridgman, 1852)
jtodd-daughter-at-school: The daughter at school (Northampton [Mass.] Hopkins, Bridgman and company, 1854)
jtodd-sabbath-school-teacher: The Sabbath school teacher : designed to aid in elevating and perfecting the Sabbath school system (Northampton, Mass. : Hopkins, Bridgman & co., 1856)

_excluded.jtodd-other: Index Rerum (a blank commonplace-book index, 1839); The Lost Sister of Wyoming (a tale, 1842); Robert Bentley Todd's Cyclopaedia of Anatomy and other John Todds
